title: Pregnant Blend 4-Mix Solo #29 (대각 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her early 50s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her upper silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward just as prominently, the bust and the belly together forming the two dominant curves of her frame. Round hips and soft thighs continue below. Her head looks small between her massive bust and belly. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, smooth healthy skin, defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips, a poised, mature, confident expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 25 clicker rings piercings set with pearls in gold-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of rose-gold a bracelet. Full body painted in 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 36% of the way down her figure from the top, about 54% of the way down her figure from the top and about 72% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls), wide carved cream bands following the contours of the body, with leaf scrolls filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with geometric star filigree filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines), wide mother-of-pearl bands following the contours of the body, with dense scrollwork filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
